rule: GOAL: Place colored blocks into slots to match the top row's sequence. CONTROLS: Click a color swatch to select it, then click an empty slot to place the block. RULE: Blocks must be placed in the exact left-to-right order shown by the colored outlines at the top. TRAP: Believing you can place blocks in any order; skipping the required sequence wastes steps and fails the level.

GOAL: Navigate a grid maze from start to finish using the shortest path. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one block at a time, passing through gray doors. RULE: Only even-coordinate rooms and gray connecting doors are passable; black walls block all movement. TRAP: Assuming each keypress moves you to the next room rather than a single grid block, causing misaligned pathing.

GOAL: Guide the purple token along the dotted path to reach the blue ball at the far end. CONTROLS: Click directly on a path dot within three steps of the token to jump there instantly. RULE: You can only move up to three connected dots per click, skipping intermediate steps efficiently. TRAP: Assuming you must click every single dot; this wastes moves. Always aim for the third dot ahead.

GOAL: Pour liquid onto the bar to catch it in the left cup. CONTROLS: Arrows move the bar; Space pours the liquid. RULE: Liquid flows to the far edge, so align the bar's right end with the pour to force a leftward flow. TRAP: Assuming liquid flows to the nearest edge wastes time; it actually runs to the opposite side.

GOAL: Align the gray slabs by moving the handle to match the wall's gap. CONTROLS: Click the blue handle to shift it right, causing the top gray edge to move left and the bottom edge to move right simultaneously. RULE: The gray shape stretches symmetrically; the sum of the top edge position and the handle position remains constant. TRAP: Assuming the handle moves the entire gray block as one rigid unit; it actually mirrors the movement across a central axis.

GOAL: Place three blocks into matching slots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character; Space attaches or detaches an adjacent block. RULE: Blocks can be carried in any direction regardless of facing, as long as they are adjacent. TRAP: Believing you must face a specific direction to attach or detach a block wastes time and causes unnecessary movement.

GOAL: Move the handle right by balancing white space across three horizontal bands. CONTROLS: Click blue tiles near walls to transfer white space between adjacent bands. RULE: The middle band acts as a buffer; it must absorb space from both the top and bottom bands to allow the handle to pass. TRAP: Assuming only the bottom wall controls movement; ignoring the top wall’s blue tiles leaves the middle band too small to clear the obstacle.

GOAL: Arrange colored tiles into a specific target pattern using only slot-to-slot swaps. CONTROLS: Click a filled slot to select it, then click another slot to swap their contents. Press space to verify the arrangement. RULE: Selections always result in a direct exchange between two positions; nothing is ever discarded or added to the palette. TRAP: Believing you could park a tile in the gray palette holes to simplify the cycle, which is impossible.

GOAL: Merge two purple tokens into a yellow one by clicking between them. CONTROLS: Clicking a spot pulls any token within range directly to that point. RULE: Tokens merge only when multiple land on the exact same click location. TRAP: Thinking any click works; picking a spot too far from one token leaves it behind.

GOAL: Place seven colored items into five main slots and two side boxes. CONTROLS: Click a color to select it, click a slot to place it, press space to finish. RULE: When reaching a colored ring, fill that matching side box completely before returning to the main line. TRAP: Assuming items go left-to-right in the main box regardless of rings; ignoring the ring diverts items to side boxes first.

GOAL: Shrink the plug tip by absorbing patterns, then slide it left into the head. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; actions trigger absorption to reduce its size. RULE: Each absorption halves the tip's dimensions, allowing it to pass through narrow gaps. TRAP: Believing the tip stays full-size; failing to shrink it blocks entry into the socket.

GOAL: Reach the exit past the sleeping guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the player one tile. RULE: The guard stays still while vertical, allowing safe passage around them. TRAP: Assuming the guard chases immediately or that its room is fatal; it was dormant until disturbed.

GOAL: Place the ring in the third main slot to route colors through the green box, matching the pre-filled green in the correct sequence position. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, then click empty slots to place. Press space to submit. RULE: The flow order skips the ring slot, inserting the green box items instead, so the ring’s position determines where green colors appear. TRAP: Assuming the ring is just another color; it actually re-routes the sequence, requiring exact placement to align with the pre-filled green.

GOAL: Guide the sliding block to reach the target zone. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block; clicking targets triggers absorption. RULE: Absorbing targets shifts the block significantly, often clearing obstacles instantly. TRAP: Assuming manual movement is always required; using clicks to trigger absorption solves the puzzle in one step instead of dozens.

GOAL: Raise white fluid in outer regions to align three green plugs while keeping middle regions empty. CONTROLS: Click blue bridges to transfer two units of fluid between adjacent regions. RULE: Fluid cannot rise above the top of the wall separating regions; it spills or blocks instead. TRAP: Assuming walls only block sideways flow; ignoring their height as a strict ceiling causes wasted moves.

GOAL: Move the plug down to the socket. CONTROLS: Click dashes and bars to set movement rules. RULE: Activating both a dash and a bar in a column makes the plug move down. TRAP: Assuming dashes alone move horizontally; ignoring the down rule caused wasted moves.

GOAL: Navigate the grid to the red exit while managing the sleeping guard. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the player one room per press. RULE: Entering the sleeping guard's room from behind consumed it, removing the obstacle. TRAP: Assuming the guard was an invincible wall that must be bypassed rather than absorbed.

GOAL: Fill a nine-slot sequence using a six-color palette and two rings. CONTROLS: Click swatches to place them, then press space to clear. RULE: Passing a ring twice forces its slot to repeat, creating a double-traversal loop that exactly matches the sequence length. TRAP: Assuming every position is visited only once ignores the ring mechanic, making the color counts seem impossible.

GOAL: Deliver two tokens to matching balls. CONTROLS: Click to move tokens toward targets; clicking near two tokens merges them. RULE: Tokens must land precisely on their corresponding balls to count as delivered. TRAP: Placing a token on a ball does not remove it; both goals must be satisfied simultaneously to win.

GOAL: Fill the main box with three color rings to direct the sequence into matching child boxes. CONTROLS: Click palette rings to place them in the main box slots. RULE: Each ring sends its group to the child box pre-filled with that ring’s color. TRAP: Assuming rings go to boxes by name rather than matching the pre-filled start color.

ESTABLISHED: The head starts at rows 30-35 with a short rod. Red and green blocks are already correctly placed at columns 18 and 24. Blue is misplaced at column 42 in a higher row. The goal requires all three blocks aligned in the head's row at columns 18, 24, and 30. FAILED: Previous attempts failed because the blue block was not moved to the correct column and row alignment. GOAL IS NOT: The goal is not merely extending the rod to maximum length or leaving blocks in their current misaligned positions. CONTROLS: Moving the head horizontally extends or retracts the rod. Vertical movement shift

ESTABLISHED: Five columns exist. Column 0 is one step from its target if moved down; Column 3 is three steps from its target if moved up. Columns 1, 2, and 4 have unknown offsets to their respective partner glyphs. FAILED: Blindly cycling columns without tracking phase or assuming a single global rotation fixed the puzzle. GOAL IS NOT: A simple left-to-right sequence where one button press fixes everything, nor is it about clearing all columns to the exact same glyph. CONTROLS: LEFT/RIGHT moves the cursor between columns. UP/DOWN rotates the current column's glyph.

GOAL: Match all five columns to their partner glyphs by rotating each to the correct phase. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and rotate the selected column's glyph. RULE: Each column must align with its specific partner glyph, requiring precise phase matching. TRAP: Assuming uniform rotation direction or phase; probing blindly wastes actions when exact down/up counts are known.

GOAL: Align yellow glyphs to match the pink row's specific rotations. CONTROLS: Arrows cycled through glyph variants; UP advanced the selection. RULE: The required rotation for each slot matched the corresponding pink glyph's orientation. TRAP: Assuming all glyphs needed the same rotation wasted time on blind cycling instead of checking the pink reference first.

GOAL: Move the plug up four spaces to reach the socket. CONTROLS: Toggle switches to set directions, then click the ball to run the program. RULE: A dash in the top row paired with a bar in the bottom row commands an upward move. TRAP: Thinking the simulator view was flipped relative to the device, when both actually share the same orientation.

GOAL: Move two colored crosses to align their arms over matching dots. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the white marker; Space swaps the active cross. RULE: A cross collects dots only when its arms fully cover them. TRAP: Assuming crosses move one pixel per press; they jump three, causing overshoots.

GOAL: Rotate seven yellow slots to match the pink target glyphs above them. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; UP rotates the current slot; RIGHT shifts to the next slot. RULE: Each slot cycles through rotations; stop when the shape matches the target regardless of orientation. TRAP: Assuming distinct orientations matter for ambiguous shapes, causing you to over-rotate instead of stopping at the first visual match.

GOAL: Place the knot at the ring center to win. CONTROLS: Clicking moves the white head; the gray tail swaps with the head. RULE: The knot sits exactly halfway between the head and tail positions. TRAP: Believing the head alone must reach the target wastes time; the midpoint is key.

GOAL: Guide the red marker to the cross's center and the yellow marker to its center. CONTROLS: Clicking a bar moves its marker forward three spaces, extending the bar behind it. RULE: Only the marker's position matters for completion; the bar's length is irrelevant. TRAP: Trying to align the bar's tip with the cross instead of the marker wastes moves.

GOAL: Align the X-shape so its diagonal arms touch all three scattered orange dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the entire X structure one step per press. RULE: A dot counts as collected only if it sits exactly on one of the X’s two crossing diagonals. TRAP: Assuming the visual center of the drawn shape is the logical center; the marker can be hidden under overlapping graphics, causing you to misjudge alignment.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to place the yellow block into the yellow bracket. CONTROLS: Red clicks rotated the ring counter-clockwise; green clicks rotated it clockwise. RULE: The yellow bracket marks the target slot for the yellow block. TRAP: Assuming arrows only move blocks linearly rather than rotating the entire circular ring.

GOAL: Move the selected cross to the ghost position using two clicks. CONTROLS: Click the cross to select it, then click the ghost to move it. RULE: A cross moves to the ghost location when both are clicked in sequence. TRAP: Clicking the already-selected cross again deselects it, wasting a turn.

GOAL: Move the X marker to the target corner. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space selects the next piece. RULE: Pieces move three cells per press, ignoring obstacles. TRAP: Overlapping pieces do not block movement or collect dots during transit.

GOAL: Transform the all-blue target grid into the specific red-and-blue pattern displayed on the mini-grid within that same panel. CONTROLS: Clicking any cell inside a panel toggles the colors of that cell and its immediate neighbors, acting like a brush. RULE: The mini-grid embedded in each panel is the literal solution key for that panel's large grid; match it exactly. TRAP: Assuming the mini-grid shows the current state or a generic template; it actually reveals the unique goal pattern for that specific quadrant.

GOAL: Make two agents collide in the top band. CONTROLS: Arrows move the left agent normally and the right agent mirrored. RULE: Pressing RIGHT sends both agents toward the center column on the top row. TRAP: Assuming standard movement for the right agent ignores the mirror control scheme.

GOAL: Match the grid to the target pattern shown by the two mini maps. CONTROLS: Click blue cells to toggle them orange; ignore the fixed mini centers. RULE: Each mini dictates the colors for its specific 3x3 neighborhood, including overlapping rows. TRAP: Believing minis are mere decoration; they are the strict blueprint for every cell in their zone.

GOAL: Position yellow blocks on the two bracketed cells by rotating interconnected tracks. CONTROLS: Three buttons rotate distinct loops of blocks clockwise around shared junctions. RULE: Blocks transfer between overlapping loops at intersection cells, linking separate cycles into one system. TRAP: Assuming loops act independently; rotating one loop shifts shared blocks, unexpectedly altering other tracks.

GOAL: Match every cell to its region's center color. CONTROLS: Click empty cells to flip their color state. RULE: White pixels adopt the center color; gray pixels adopt the base color. TRAP: Assuming a universal color swap ignores that each region defines its own white-to-center mapping.

GOAL: Seat the charcoal block inside the right ring. CONTROLS: Arrows push the active block; clicks select a new active block. RULE: Pushing a block into the purple wall teleports it to the mirrored position on the right panel. TRAP: Thinking the wall blocks movement; it actually transports the block to the other side.

ESTABLISHED: The yellow bar drains one unit per step, leaving twenty-two steps. The top box glyph remains static while the plug rotates on the cross. FAILED: Moving left through the gray corridor did not trigger any event or change the state. GOAL IS NOT: Reaching the dark region is not the objective, as it appears to be a hazard or hole rather than a target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; rotation is automatic or tied to movement; the timer decreases with every action taken.

GOAL: Guide two heads to move their respective blocks so the average position of each group lands in its target ring. CONTROLS: Click a target to move the head there; click a block to swap its position with the head. RULE: The group’s center is the exact average of the head and its two assigned blocks’ coordinates. TRAP: Assuming the head stays fixed; it must actively travel to specific spots to shift the group’s center into the ring.

GOAL: Navigate both agents through narrow gaps to the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active agent; the other waits or moves in sync. RULE: Only pure black tiles are safe; red checker patterns are lethal hazards. TRAP: Assuming all empty-looking spaces are safe; half-colored tiles near boundaries can hide lethal red pixels.

GOAL: Move Y to L13 and O to R5 using 17 clicks. CONTROLS: L+ rotates left slots; L- reverses; R+ rotates right; R- reverses. RULE: Shared cells link the two cycles, letting blocks switch paths. TRAP: Assuming other blocks matter; they are irrelevant to the goal.

GOAL: Guide the collectors to their matching colored dots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected collector; the spacebar switches which collector is active. RULE: A collector only collects a dot when its color matches the dot’s color. TRAP: Assuming you can collect any dot regardless of current color, forcing extra moves to fix color alignment.

GOAL: Recreate a symmetric pattern of red, orange, and blue tiles across the grid. CONTROLS: Clicking a tile cycles its color through blue, red, then orange. RULE: Each mini-grid enforces a strict two-color constraint, forcing specific hues on shared tiles. TRAP: Assuming the color cycle starts with orange wastes clicks; verify the sequence begins with blue.

GOAL: Route the plug through the maze to connect with the target panel. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; mouse clicks select it and place it. RULE: The plug must stay strictly on the wire path, turning only at corners. TRAP: Believing you can jump diagonally or cut corners wastes moves; stick to the grid lines.

GOAL: Move the yellow and orange blocks to their target spots to open the path. CONTROLS: Click green arrows to shift pieces forward; red arrows reverse the movement. RULE: Shifting a column pushes items up, but the top item jumps to the bottom of the linked column, not its own. TRAP: Assuming the loop stays within one column wastes moves; remember the cross-column wrap-around.

GOAL: Rotate the glyph to match the target, then return the plug to its starting dock. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug across the grid. RULE: The win condition only triggers when the plug is docked and the glyph orientation is correct. TRAP: Assuming the plug's initial position was safe or that matching the glyph anywhere would win.

ESTABLISHED: The blue piece sits on the socket. A red plug blocks the exit. Moving left retracts the plug but forces the blue piece out immediately. FAILED: Pressing down from the socket did not move the blue piece or shift the plug. GOAL IS NOT: Simply leaving the socket to clear the path, as the plug returns instantly. CONTROLS: Left moves the blue piece and resets the plug. Down is unresponsive.

GOAL: Align the plug’s prongs with the red sockets to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; Space rotates it. RULE: Rotation direction matters; ensure prongs face the target before moving. TRAP: Assuming rotation preserves position; it often shifts the plug’s alignment.

GOAL: Toggle eight specific plain cells to match the target pattern, correcting errors caused by previous moves. CONTROLS: Click a plain cell to flip its state between North and South. RULE: Activating a checker toggles itself and all four orthogonal neighbors, often altering cells that were already correct. TRAP: Assuming checker activations only help without side effects, which wasted time by flipping necessary cells into the wrong state.

GOAL: Route seven shapes through a color chain to form specific yellow targets. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the cursor and cycled shape slots. RULE: Each shape’s color had to match the next shape’s entry color exactly. TRAP: Assuming any rotation worked; only the correct alignment allowed the chain to proceed.

GOAL: Rotate all tiles to form a single 21-cell cycle. CONTROLS: Green arrows spin the entire loop forward. Red arrows reverse it. RULE: Every tile must match its successor in one continuous, unbroken chain. TRAP: Assuming the top row spins independently; it is locked into the main loop.

GOAL: Align the charcoal piece with the yellow target to complete the mirror puzzle. CONTROLS: Down moves pieces down; Left moves the charcoal right, revealing mirrored movement. RULE: The black shape is always the horizontal mirror of the charcoal piece. TRAP: Assuming standard directional controls causes delays, as Left actually shifts the piece right.

GOAL: Light the correct vertical bars to match the horizontal dash pattern. CONTROLS: Click a vertical bar column to toggle its light on or off. RULE: A bar lights up only if its position aligns with a lit dash segment. TRAP: Assuming all visible bar positions are clickable; some columns are decorative or inactive.

GOAL: Move three collectors to precise spots to gather all dots of their matching color. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active collector; Space switches to the next one. RULE: Each collector only picks up dots matching its current color. TRAP: Assuming the selection marker is always visible; it can hide, so track positions mentally.

GOAL: Guide the rotating arm to the top position, then select and pour the correct liquid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the arm in specific directions, while clicks and spacebar handle item selection and pouring. RULE: The arm cannot sweep through solid blocks, forcing you to reverse direction when hitting a barrier. TRAP: Assuming all arrow keys rotate the same way wastes time; each key has unique movement limits.

GOAL: Guide the dot to the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the dot; clicks toggle barriers. RULE: Toggle switches before moving to align paths through gaps. TRAP: Assuming all colored zones are passable; some block movement until toggled.

GOAL: Paint the bottom-left triangle white and bottom-right triangle orange. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the nozzle, clicks pick paint, space pours. RULE: Each nozzle angle covers a specific diagonal band of cells. TRAP: Believing the bottom angle covers only the lowest row; it actually covers the entire bottom half.

GOAL: Raise the boat to the top by clearing the cork path. CONTROLS: Clicks destroyed obstacles; arrows moved the boat. RULE: The boat rises when water supports it, blocked by solid corks. TRAP: Believing the boat could push through corks instead of destroying them first.

GOAL: Align the plug’s reflection with the yellow target by positioning both the plug and the mirror. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selected object; Space toggled selection between the plug and the mirror. RULE: The mirror reflects the plug; correct alignment required calculating the mirror’s center to match the target’s position. TRAP: Forgetting to toggle selection caused arrow presses to move the wrong object, wasting actions on misaligned parts.

GOAL: Reach the yellow square by opening a path through the red barrier. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; clicking side icons rotates specific colored bars. RULE: Stepping on the red button grants the ability to toggle the red bar. TRAP: Believing the red bar rotates automatically or via a different trigger, ignoring the need to physically step on the switch first.

GOAL: Fill the nested boxes so the colored flow matches the target sequence. CONTROLS: Click a palette swatch to select it, then click a box slot to place it. RULE: A ring piece in a slot redirects the flow into the corresponding child box. TRAP: Assuming rings only belong in the main box; they are essential for routing flow into nested children.

GOAL: Connect four shapes by docking matching tips until all red marks turn gray. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space rotates it clockwise; click to select a piece. RULE: A docked pair turns gray only if both tips align perfectly with no gaps. TRAP: Rotating around the piece center instead of the bounding box corner shifts targets unexpectedly.

GOAL: Align black plugs to cover yellow nodes, using reflections to match targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected plug; Space cycles selection between plugs and mirror. RULE: A plug’s reflection must exactly cover a yellow node to lock it in place. TRAP: Moving the mirror strip instead of the plug; ensure the correct plug is selected before moving.

GOAL: Fill the grid with four colors by pouring paint into a rotating block. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the block; number keys select paint colors; spacebar pours the selected color. RULE: Paint only fills empty cells in the current orientation, so rotate before pouring to target specific regions. TRAP: Assuming paint covers all visible empty cells regardless of rotation, causing spills into unwanted areas.

GOAL: Align the U-shape and vertical bar into the yellow cross outline. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space cycles between the mirror, U-shape, and bar. RULE: The mirror reflects pieces, so you must position them relative to their reflection, not the target itself. TRAP: Assuming the mirror is fixed; it actually moves down to reveal the correct alignment zones.
